# Third-party and reused code

* `src/core/rng.[ch]` — adapted from `super-fabio-bros/engine/core/math/rng.[ch]`
  (MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2026 Andrea Laforgia). Renamed types, same xorshift32 algorithm.
* SDL2 and SDL2_image (zlib licence) are linked dynamically; they are not vendored.
* No third-party art, audio, fonts or sprite sheets are used. All graphics are generated by
  `tools/assetgen/*` and all audio by `tools/audiogen/*`.
* `src/core/collision.[ch]`, `src/core/stepper.[ch]` — copied from `super-fabio-bros/engine/core/{math,time}`
  (MIT, (c) 2026 Andrea Laforgia), include guards/paths adjusted only. Used for every hit test and the fixed-step loop.
* Reviewed but deliberately NOT reused: `animate`/`physics` (tied to the engine's graphics-context and vector types),
  `object_pool` (heap-allocating; this game keeps fixed arrays so nothing allocates in the main loop),
  the SDL_Renderer-based graphics/audio layers (this game requires direct OpenGL and its own mixer).
